top_signals.title: India Boosts LIC Share Sale to $3.3 Billion on Strong Demand
top_signals.summary: India on Tuesday expanded the size of its share sale in the state-run insurance giant to raise $3.3 billion after the base offer was oversubscribed, bolstering public finances amid challenges posed by high oil prices.
